description: This file contains unit tests for the PersonDAO component in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing database interactions related to PersonAttributeType and PersonName entities.

classes.name: PersonDAOTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to verify the behavior of PersonDAO's database operations.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the PersonDAO object before each test by fetching it from the Spring application context.

methods.name: getSavedPersonAttributeTypeName_shouldGetSavedPersonAttributeTypeNameFromDatabase
methods.description: Tests retrieving the original name of a PersonAttributeType from the database.

methods.name: getPersonName_shouldGetSavedPersonNameById
methods.description: Verifies that a PersonName can be fetched correctly by its ID.

methods.name: getPersonName_shouldNotGetPersonNameGivenInvalidId
methods.description: Ensures that fetching a PersonName with an invalid ID returns null.

methods.name: getSavedPersonAttributeTypeSearchable_shouldFetchSearchablePropertyForAPersonAttributeTypeBypassingCache
methods.description: Checks that the 'searchable' property of PersonAttributeType is fetched correctly from the database, ignoring any cache.
